Title: ISSUE-0001: Upgrade Node.js Environment to 20.x+
Body: The current environment is running Node.js 18.19.1. However, the project's dependencies (Next.js 16/19) and the specific version of 'next lint' require Node.js >=20.9.0. This mismatch is currently blocking the execution of the CI/CD linting phase.

Title: ISSUE-0002: Missing Vitest Coverage Dependency
Body: Total project coverage is currently unmeasurable because the required coverage provider '@vitest/coverage-v8' is missing from the development dependencies.

Title: ISSUE-0003: Zero Logic Coverage for Core Hooks
Body: The core business logic of the application resides in custom React hooks (useAuth, useForm, useForms), but they currently have 0% functional test coverage. The existing tests only verify that the hooks are functions.

Title: ISSUE-0004: Resolve Documentation Linting Violations
Body: Multiple markdown files are violating project style rules, primarily regarding heading hierarchy and table formatting.

Title: ISSUE-0005: Implement Edge Case Validations in Form Builder
Body: The form builder currently lacks frontend-level validation for several identified edge cases, which could lead to API errors or data corruption.

Title: ISSUE-0006: Implementation of Conditional Logic Engine
Body: Users need to define rules for showing or hiding fields based on respondent answers. Currently, this capability is missing from the form builder.

Title: ISSUE-0007: Implementation of Response Data Export
Body: Administrators need to export collected form responses for external analysis. While buttons exist in the UI, they are not integrated with the backend.

Title: ISSUE-0008: AI Form Generation Assistant
Body: To accelerate form creation, an AI assistant is required to generate form fields from natural language descriptions.

Title: ISSUE-0009: PWA Support
Body: respondents need to access forms in environments with poor connectivity. PWA support will provide offline capabilities and an installable app experience.

Title: ISSUE-0010: Form Versioning UI Management
Body: While the backend types support versioning, the frontend lacks the UI to switch between or manage multiple versions of a single form.

Title: ISSUE-0011: Workflow Automation (MVP)
Body: Forms need to trigger external actions (like notifications) upon submission. Currently, there is no system to define or execute these workflows.

Title: ISSUE-0012: Docker Non-Root User Execution
Body: Current Docker configuration defaults to running as root inside the container, which is a security risk in production environments.

Title: ISSUE-0013: Setup GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline
Body: The project lacks automated testing and deployment pipelines. All checks must currently be run manually.

Title: ISSUE-0014: Core Hook Refactor & PR Remediation
Body: Core hooks (useAuth, useForm) required refactoring for architectural consistency (absolute imports) and centralized API endpoint management.
